# STEM Sprouts

> STEM Sprouts is a youth-led nonprofit building a global network of student-run STEM chapters, powered by Pinboard, our free open-source hardware coding platform. Chapters run hands-on STEM programming for K-5 students from Georgia to Kenya to India.

STEM Sprouts pairs a free block-coding platform (Pinboard) for Arduino and Raspberry Pi with a student-led chapter model, so any student, anywhere in the world, can bring hands-on STEM to their own community.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://stem-sprouts.org/): Overview of STEM Sprouts' mission, chapters, and impact.
- [About](https://stem-sprouts.org/about): Who STEM Sprouts is and what the organization believes.
- [Locations](https://stem-sprouts.org/locations): Current chapter locations around the world.
- [Pinboard](https://stem-sprouts.org/pinboard): The free, open-source block-coding platform for Arduino and Raspberry Pi.
- [Policy Fellowship](https://stem-sprouts.org/policy-fellowship): Student research fellowship on STEM education and technology policy.
- [Partner](https://stem-sprouts.org/partner): How schools, companies, and organizations can partner with STEM Sprouts.
- [Resources](https://stem-sprouts.org/resources): Free tools and platforms for continuing STEM learning at home.
- [News](https://stem-sprouts.org/news): Updates, announcements, and research from STEM Sprouts.

## Legal

- [Legal & Tax-Exempt Status](https://stem-sprouts.org/legal): Fiscal sponsorship and tax-exempt status through The Hack Foundation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://stem-sprouts.org/privacy): How STEM Sprouts collects, uses, and protects information.
